item.title: Paul Graham On Startups, Ambition, and Great Founders
item.description: YC Visiting Partner Vivian Shen sits down with Paul Graham at the original YC office in Mountain View to talk about startups, AI, ambition, and what makes great founders. From the Y Combinator Startup Podcast, 5 Sep 2026. Full episode, about 21 min.

item.title: Tibo Sottiaux: OpenAI Head of ChatGPT on the next era of AI
item.description: Lenny Rachitsky talks with Tibo Sottiaux, who leads ChatGPT and Codex at OpenAI, about always-on agents, Dots, which skills matter more in the AI era, and how OpenAI ships. Conversation, not a product demo. First 30 minutes of the Lenny's Podcast episode. Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MM-C3JqCXBk

item.title: Sergey Brin and the Gemini team on Gemini 4 Argon
item.description: Logan Kilpatrick hosts Sergey Brin, Josh Woodward, Tulsee Doshi and Melvin Johnson from Google for a conversation about Gemini 4 Argon, how the team got here, and the path ahead. Shared on X by Logan Kilpatrick.

item.title: Paige Bailey: Build Everyday Apps With Gemini (No Code)
item.description: Google DeepMind's Paige Bailey on Everyday AI, showing how non-coders can build apps with Gemini and Nano Banana, use AI in Google Sheets, and ship practical tools without writing code. About 30 minutes.

item.title: Greg Brockman: Start Building With AI Before You Feel Ready
item.description: OpenAI co-founder Greg Brockman on the Silicon Valley Girl podcast, talking about what AI can already do for everyday people, proactive AI assistants, and why he expects a wave of new one-person businesses. First 30 minutes.

item.title: Elon Musk: What Comes Next for Humanity
item.description: Elon Musk at X Takeover, Giga Texas, 10 Oct 2026 (Tesla Owners Silicon Valley). Tesla's near-death years, Starship, AI, Optimus and Cybercab. Starts at the 15-minute mark, where Musk comes on.
